Annual Report 2025 /2026

The Board of Dipped Products PLC (‘DPL’) is pleased to confirm that, throughout the financial year
2025/26, DPL complied with the applicable corporate governance provisions and disclosure practices required
of a Sri Lanka incorporated listed company. The Company’s governance framework, aligned with that of its
parent company, Hayleys PLC, provides the foundation for effective oversight, sound decision-making, risk
management and accountability, supporting the Group’s long-term resilience and sustainable value creation.

15.2   Amalgamation of DPL Premier Gloves Ltd with Dipped Products PLC.
D P L Premier Gloves Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of Dipped Products PLC was amalgamated with Dipped Products PLC with effect
from August 1, 2025 in accordance with the provisions of the Companies Act No. 07 of 2007. The amalgamation represents a business
combination under common control and is outside the scope of SLFRS 3 – Business Combinations. Accordingly, the transaction has been
accounted for using the pooling of interests method in accordance with the Group’s accounting policy developed under LKAS 8 – Accounting
Policies, Changes in Accounting Estimates and Errors.
